column3: “Leb-qamai” (“heart of those who rise against me”) is a cipher for Chaldea; NASB keeps it as a name. “Wind” is rendered “spirit.”
“Strangers” follows the vowels; another reading gives “winnowers.”
The Hebrew writes a second “bend” that is not read; NASB has “bend it.”
“Fill the shields” is rendered “fill the quivers”; the word is uncertain.
“Cubit of your cutting off” is rendered “The measure of your end.”
“Persons” is rendered “a population,” and “shout” as “shouts of victory.”
“To the sound of his giving” is rendered “When He utters His voice.”
The Hebrew lacks “Israel” (cf. 10:16); NASB has “And of the tribe of His inheritance.”
The TARGET data places “chariot and its rider” at the start of v. 22; in the Hebrew it ends v. 21. This is a data division issue.
“Standard” is rendered “signal,” and “consecrate on it” as “Consecrate … against her.”
“Officials” is rendered “prefects,” and “his dominion” as “their dominion.”
